name: desktop-history-fixture-copy
goal: Render realistic Desktop history identities, useful event details and plausible failure messages

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Visual review 3 rejects every HistoryPanel image for repeated placeholder hashes, title-echo event details and synthetic error text. The private Desktop dataset carries these placeholders into pending widgets too.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standard catalog cases checked text presence and layout, and review accepted fixture boilerplate. Extend the same post-capture guard to reject repeated-hex ids, title-echo details and synthetic failure wording; preserve all case identities.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed guard 95a4a02858 rejects placeholder history content: record b30c0085d270a9156379be755f523ceb8400eec70573622f68f273d91903157b, 18 failures and 3 empty-state passes; all 21 original captures retained.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Private Desktop DTOs now use consistent realistic commit identities; HistoryPanel has meaningful event details and a plausible load failure. Checked artifact bytes remain unchanged. Fixture edits require independent after-capture rather than matched green.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
